name: M3_MWS420MI_LstPickList
description: List picking lists that match the selection criteria you provide and view their main header details. The operation returns one record per picking list, including delivery number and suffix, warehouse and stock zone, picking and packing statuses, estimated and actual pick times, assigned team and picker, wave number, gross weight, volume, and basic customer and departure information. Use the result to monitor warehouse workload, follow up picking progress, and identify specific picking lists before printing, confirming, or updating them through other maintenance operations.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse used to limit the picking lists returned.

inputParameters.name: FPIS
inputParameters.description: Lowest picking status to include when selecting picking lists.

inputParameters.name: TPIS
inputParameters.description: Highest picking status to include when selecting picking lists.

inputParameters.name: RORC
inputParameters.description: Reference order category used to select picking lists for specific types of orders such as customer or distribution orders.

inputParameters.name: SLTP
inputParameters.description: Stock zone used to filter picking lists by warehouse zone.

inputParameters.name: TEAM
inputParameters.description: Picking team used to select picking lists assigned to a specific team.

inputParameters.name: PICK
inputParameters.description: Picker ID used to select picking lists assigned to a specific picker.

inputParameters.name: DLIX
inputParameters.description: Delivery number used to select picking lists for a specific delivery.

inputParameters.name: PLSX
inputParameters.description: Picking list suffix used to identify a specific picking list for the delivery.

inputParameters.name: PISE
inputParameters.description: Warehouse equipment used to select picking lists requiring a specific piece of equipment.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number for the picking list.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse where this picking list is executed.

outputParameters.name: DLIX
outputParameters.description: Delivery number associated with this picking list.

outputParameters.name: PLSX
outputParameters.description: Suffix identifying this specific picking list for the delivery.

outputParameters.name: PISS
outputParameters.description: Current picking status of this picking list.

outputParameters.name: SLTP
outputParameters.description: Stock zone from which goods are picked on this picking list.

outputParameters.name: PISE
outputParameters.description: Warehouse equipment required or used for this picking list.

outputParameters.name: PLTM
outputParameters.description: Estimated time required to pick the goods on this picking list.

outputParameters.name: SEEQ
outputParameters.description: Sequence or priority in which this picking list should be processed.

outputParameters.name: ESPD
outputParameters.description: Estimated date when picking should start for this picking list based on planned departure.

outputParameters.name: ESPT
outputParameters.description: Estimated time when picking should start for this picking list.

outputParameters.name: TEAM
outputParameters.description: Picking team responsible for this picking list.

outputParameters.name: PICK
outputParameters.description: Picker assigned as responsible for this picking list.

outputParameters.name: PLRI
outputParameters.description: Wave number grouping this picking list into a picking wave.

outputParameters.name: WPIC
outputParameters.description: User who has reserved this picking list in the workflow so others cannot use it simultaneously.

outputParameters.name: ARLD
outputParameters.description: Date when this picking list was last printed.

outputParameters.name: ARLT
outputParameters.description: Time when this picking list was last printed.

outputParameters.name: ARLE
outputParameters.description: Date when picking actually started for this picking list.

outputParameters.name: ARLF
outputParameters.description: Time when picking actually started for this picking list.

outputParameters.name: NPLL
outputParameters.description: Original number of picking lines created on this picking list.

outputParameters.name: NPLR
outputParameters.description: Number of picking lines on this picking list that have been reported.

outputParameters.name: NPLP
outputParameters.description: Number of picking lines on this picking list that have been reported as picked.

outputParameters.name: CLOD
outputParameters.description: Closing date after which additional order lines are not included on this picking list.

outputParameters.name: CLOT
outputParameters.description: Closing time after which additional order lines are not included on this picking list.

outputParameters.name: DEV
outputParameters.description: Printer assigned to print this picking list.

outputParameters.name: DEVW
outputParameters.description: Printer used when printing wave picking lists that include this picking list.

outputParameters.name: TWLO
outputParameters.description: Destination warehouse for the delivery associated with this picking list.

outputParameters.name: OLIX
outputParameters.description: Original delivery number from which this picking list was created, when different from the current delivery number.

outputParameters.name: RGDT
outputParameters.description: Date when this picking list record was created.

outputParameters.name: RGTM
outputParameters.description: Time when this picking list record was created.

outputParameters.name: LMDT
outputParameters.description: Date when this picking list record was last changed.

outputParameters.name: CHNO
outputParameters.description: Change sequence number incremented each time this picking list record is updated.

outputParameters.name: CHID
outputParameters.description: User ID of the person or process that last changed this picking list record.

outputParameters.name: DSDT
outputParameters.description: Planned departure date for the delivery on this picking list.

outputParameters.name: DSHM
outputParameters.description: Planned departure time for the delivery on this picking list.

outputParameters.name: TRDT
outputParameters.description: Transaction date associated with this picking list or its delivery.

outputParameters.name: GRWE
outputParameters.description: Total gross weight of the goods on this picking list.

outputParameters.name: PGRS
outputParameters.description: Delivery status for the delivery associated with this picking list.

outputParameters.name: PIST
outputParameters.description: Packing status for the delivery associated with this picking list.

outputParameters.name: CUNO
outputParameters.description: Customer number for the customer associated with this picking list's delivery.

outputParameters.name: CUNM
outputParameters.description: Name of the customer associated with this picking list's delivery.

outputParameters.name: RORC
outputParameters.description: Reference order category indicating the type of order behind this picking list.

outputParameters.name: VLME
outputParameters.description: Estimated total volume of the goods on this picking list.

outputParameters.name: VOL3
outputParameters.description: Actual total volume of the goods on this picking list.
